title: Walking in the Provision of God Every Day
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares the key to walking in the provision of God every day: being a doer of His word, not just a hearer. By treating God as our loving Father and forming a personal relationship with Him, we can stay humble, thankful, and filled with joy, even in the midst of life's storms. Join Pastor Chris as he teaches us how to experience the blessings of God in our daily lives.
